text:
alex.k: Anyone else see that `billing-analyst` can open the org usage dashboard? I thought that role shouldn't see other teams' token costs. :eyes:
lia: I just tried and can confirm. billing-analyst on my test org can see org -> all projects breakdown. Not expected.
samir: Steps to repro?
lia: 1) create role billing-analyst (no admin perms) 2) invite user 3) Console -> Analytics -> Usage -> set time range -> see per-project breakdown.
samir: Noted. Looks like analytics-service checks `can_view_usage` but that permission may have been granted via flattened inheritance after the last role refactor. Pinging eng-platform.
jon: FYI PR 2874 last week flattened role inheritance for legacy roles. It changed group_role mapping semantics, might have inadvertently given `analytics.read_all_projects` to billing-analyst via an inherited group role.
alex.k: Is there an audit log for when a user views org-costs? We need to know exposure window.
audit-bot: audit: user_viewed_org_usage events available. Query path: `/logs/audit/events`  Suggest query: `event_type:user_viewed_org_usage timeframe:168h`
maria: Immediate mitigation: remove `analytics.read_all_projects` from billing-analyst in role-mapping and disable per-project breakdown UI for non-admins via feature-flag. Also rotate any API keys for affected accounts if we see suspicious activity. :lock:
samir: I'll open a revert PR to restore previous inheritance semantics and add unit tests for analytics permission checks. Which services need the fix?
jon: analytics-service and authz-gateway for sure. Also need a migration to correct existing role_assignments in DB.
lia: I exported audit events into /tmp/usage_exposure_1795.csv and shared with sec. So far ~120 unique users viewed org-level breakdown in the past 48h.
maria: We'll need customer comms. Also check that audit exports were not copied to external buckets — verify KMS grants used for log export. If exports used a rotated key recently, confirm no gap in access control.
samir: PR 2901 created: revert flattening + add explicit `analytics.read_project` vs `analytics.read_all_projects` checks, plus e2e gating. Link: https://git.internal/r/2901
alex.k: Thanks. ETA for canary and full rollback? Also please add SRE oncall to watch for regressions.
jon: Canary rolling in 20m, full roll in 2h if green. I've paged oncall.
maria: Incident INC-2026-328 created. Triage call in 15. I'll own comms and customer notification drafts.
alex.k: Good. Keep updates here. :white_check_mark:
